question: Who agreed to acquire Brex in 2026?

hits.title: Capital One completes $2.56 billion Brex acquisition, issues stock and awards RSUs.
hits.snippet: [acquires | 2026-04-07 | $5.15 billion] Capital One acquired Brex for $5.15B on Apr 7th '26. Capital One Financial Corp. (NYSE:COF) announced Tuesday it has completed the acquisition of Brex Inc., a Delaware-based corporation, for approximately $2.56 billion in cash and 10,646,306 shares of Capital One common stock.
hits.summary: Capital One acquired Brex for $5.15B on Apr 7th '26.

hits.title: Capital One Gets Deeper Into Business Travel With $5 Billion Brex Acquisition
hits.snippet: [acquires | 2026-01-22 | $5.15 billion] Capital One was planning to acquire Brex for $5.15B on Jan 22nd '26. Capital One said Thursday it would acquire fintech platform Brex for $5.15 billion in stock and cash, a move that would enable Capital One Travel to expand into managed business travel.
hits.summary: Capital One was planning to acquire Brex for $5.15B on Jan 22nd '26.

hits.title: Brex | Brex Acquires Pry Financials to Expand Its Software Capabilities for Founders
hits.snippet: [acquires | 2022-04-01 | $90 million] Brex Inc. acquired Pry Financials Inc. for $90M on Apr 1st '22. Brex, the company reimagining finance for growing businesses, today announced its acquisition of Pry Financials, a software platform with tools designed to enable budgeting, bookkeeping and forecasting, for $90 million.
hits.summary: Brex Inc. acquired Pry Financials Inc. for $90M on Apr 1st '22.

hits.title: Brex Acquires Weav for $50 Million to Power All-in-One Finance Solution, Expands Global Reach
hits.snippet: [acquires | 2022-08-01 | $50m] Brex acquired Weav for $50M on Aug 1st '22. U.S. fintech company Brex, the all-in-one finance solution for growing businesses, today announced its $50 million acquisition of Israeli-based Weav, which offers a universal API for commerce platforms.
hits.summary: Brex acquired Weav for $50M on Aug 1st '22.

hits.title: US Fintech Firm Brex Acquires Israeli Startup Weav For $50M
hits.snippet: [acquires | 2021-08-17] Brex acquired Weav on Aug 17th '21. US fintech company Brex announced on Tuesday it has acquired Israeli startup Weav, a company that offers a universal API for commerce platforms.

hits.title: Brex acquires three companies to bolster its product line
hits.snippet: [acquires] Brex acquires Neji. By acquiring Neji, Brex is planning to enhance its security, privacy and risk posture to support its advancing product development roadmap.

hits.title: Brex Buys Three Companies | PYMNTS.com
hits.snippet: [acquires] Brex acquires Landria. San Francisco-based FinTech startup Brex has acquired Neji, Compose Labs and Landria to help it build out its product offerings for growing businesses.
